newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian drinks firms talk on Schweppes franchise.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian drinks firms talk on Schweppes franchise.

text.p: Nigeria's two biggest drinks companies are discussing a transfer of the Schweppes franchise from local Coca-Cola bottler Nigerian Bottling Company to Nigerian Breweries.
"The deal has yet to be finalised so we cannot yet talk about specifics," Larry Agose, of Nigerian Breweries told Reuters on Monday.
Sources at NBC said the bottling of Schweppes Tonic, Soda Water and Bitter Lemon drinks did not make up a major part of the company's business.

The majority state-owned Business Times newspaper on Monday quoted the President of the Nigerian Shareholders Association as saying the planned acquisition would make the soft drinks sector even more competitive and could cause casualties among smaller brands.
Nigeria's dull economy has adversely affected sales at both NBC and Nigerian Breweries, but beer consumption has been considerably worse hit than that of soft drinks.
